termination: Actual and imagined fall at root height <0.35m or upright Z<0.5. Reference end is finite-task terminal with zero tail; score terminal-step reward once. Model fall mask is hard and not differentiated.
common_prior: One identical pre-supervision zero-output checkpoint for all methods and training seeds. It includes previously fitted balance slopes, static kinematics and normalization from reference-source observations; no claim of training from scratch or a prior-free mocap method. Independently seeded collection/optimization defines the three new training runs.
data_access: Reuse the independently verified six-cycle recent-FIFO baseline, its initial/common/diagnostic data and final evaluations. Rebuild only cycles 1-3 from archived physical batches, checking actor/model/value weights against the corresponding baseline checkpoints at every cycle. All later anchor-arm collection and final evaluations are new. No source-control fitting labels or diagnostic-window fitting.
critic: Keep the original physical-return critic and 128 fitting steps each cycle. Neither actor objective uses its critic; it is reconstructed, fitted and stored without changing the training recipe.
actor_objective: Continue the existing no-tail H32 discounted-reward objective with uniform current-cycle physical-transition origins, exact causal H10 history/EMA and planned reference phase. Keep the 12 Adam steps/cycle, learning rate and 0.005 local logit RMS cap. Longer surviving episodes receive more origin weight.
budget_and_selection: Three seeds and six cycles in both arms, 27 collection episodes/cycle, 900 model/128 value fitting updates and 12 H32 no-tail actor steps/cycle, with the same 0.005 local logit RMS cap. Reuse the complete frozen FIFO results; train only the anchor arm. Reconstruct original first-three-cycle optimizer/replay/RNG state by repeating fitting operations, then intervene only in model replay composition from cycle 4. Evaluate all final actors against the unchanged 27-cell gate with no intermediate quality checks, early stopping, checkpoint or seed selection.
costs: 603 physical records are inherited, 324 new (243 later collection +81 evaluation). New local CPU wall time includes reconstruction fitting. Standalone costs retain original collection timings. Episode/update budgets match but survival can change actual transition counts. This isolates a replay recipe within the MBRL learner; it is not a successful matched model/PPO efficiency result or GPU speedup.
scope: Controlled model-replay retention comparison after six-cycle training regressed in one seed. Known reference coverage only; no generalization, skill release, hardware or complete phase acceptance claim.
protocol_revision_reason: Keep the six-cycle recipe fixed and test one response to increasing held-out model error: preserve initial training windows rather than dropping them under recent FIFO. The intervention changes model fitting distribution, not actor-origin sampling, reward, supervision, update budget or qualification limits.
model_replay: Both arms fit at most 20,000 eight-step windows. Baseline keeps the newest windows. New arm behaves identically for cycles 1-3, then retains every window from its shared first collection as a permanent initial anchor. Remaining capacity keeps the newest windows from collections 2 onward; anchor windows cannot also enter that recent pool. Uniform fitting draws over the combined pool keep original minibatch/update budgets and model normalization. Full first-collection window count varies by seed. No anchor-ratio search, extra model updates, actor-history replay or change to the current-cycle actor-origin pool.
